snippet.title: 『Annihilated』Introduction Movie【INDIE Live Expo 2026.4.25】
snippet.description:
▼Click here for the Steam store page 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2638080/Annihilated/1
 
▼Click here for the Official X
https://x.com/Annihilated_JP

▼Click here for the Official YouTube
https://www.youtube.com/@Flashlight-Games-FLG

Annihilated is set to launch on Steam on July 22, 2026.
In this dungeon-crawling RPG you must dicide who to save from the hero party.
You are the only soldier left in the rescue team, venturing deep into a labyrinth to save just one member. 
But every potential survivor is already broken: one hero can only answer yes or no, while the mage has something through the heart and can no longer use magic.
Despite its cute art style, the game delivers a grim, challenging story built around a brutal choice—who will you save?
